activity.notes: Gruevski served as prime minister from 27 August 2006 to 18 January 2016. The polity is Republic of Macedonia, not North Macedonia: the constitutional state name changed to Republic of North Macedonia only in 2019, after his premiership.

sources.title: Macedonia (11/09/11) — U.S. Department of State
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State records the VMRO-DPMNE-led government under Prime Minister Nikola Gruevski taking office after the 2006 parliamentary elections.

sources.title: Nikola Gruevski — biographical office chronology
sources.citation_text: The biographical office chronology records Gruevski's prime-ministerial term as 27 August 2006 to 18 January 2016.
